tools.name: find_alexandria_section
tools.description: Find the visitalexandria.com section that covers a topic in Alexandria, Virginia — things to do, restaurants, hotels, events, Old Town, neighborhoods, history, shopping, deals, trip planning, meetings, weddings, groups or press. Returns a working URL.

topic.description: Topic or interest, e.g. "brunch", "museums", "this weekend". Leave empty to list all sections.

tools.name: get_alexandria_agent_resources
tools.description: List the machine-readable agent-discovery resources published by visitalexandria.com, and the paths that have no index page.

tools.name: get_alexandria_events_guidance
tools.description: Return the Alexandria, Virginia events pages on visitalexandria.com and the rules for stating an event, so a past or recurring event is never presented as upcoming.
